text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
With my sweeping victory, the era of the 
'Golden Generation' ends— and the new 
dynasty of T.M. Opera O begins! The 
reigning 'Overlord of the End of the 
Century' is... none other than myself!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The Knight Commander shall be Doto! 
Residing in the castle next to the 
Overlord's shall be Ayabe-san! And 
becoming the "Twin Suns" together with me 
shall be Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The crowd roared in celebration of this 
glorious new dawn! And thus, the curtain 
fell on the dramatic birth of the 
"End-of-Century Overlord"... but my legend 
has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For this was merely the beginning of 
the legend of the End-of-Century 
Conqueror—
